requirements.label: Software engineering subject options
requirements.details: Present mathematics or computer science at A level, or Cambridge Advanced Professional in IT. The department also accepts mathematics or computer science at subsidiary level in place of the A level.

requirements.details: The programme requires mathematics at A level. The published subject rule gives no letter grade.

requirements.label: Ordinary-level subject credit
requirements.details: A School Certificate Ordinary-level credit in mathematics, a science, or a technology subject is required. The prior-learning committee may accept an alternative qualification.

requirements.label: Entry to the foundation course
requirements.details: In one SC or GCE O-level sitting, obtain at least three credits and pass English language. Also pass at least one HSC principal-level or GCE A-level subject. The Academic Council may approve equivalent qualifications.

requirements.label: HSC and London GCE routes
requirements.details: The published alternatives are passes in three HSC A levels plus one subsidiary subject, or two HSC A levels plus two subsidiaries, or three London GCE A levels.
